narrative.overview:
Wafflebase is a set of ledgers: grids, pages, slides and boards laid out on precise rules, where the document is the subject and everything around it is ruling and margin. The editors are dense, exact and quiet. Chrome sits on neutral zinc, thin borders do the work that shadows would do elsewhere, and controls stay small (28px toolbar targets, 36px form controls) so the canvas gets the room.

Warmth is the ledger's binding, not its pages. The Butter & Maple palette (syrup, butter, cream paper, walnut ink) and the Fraunces display face set the brand surfaces: the homepage, sign-in, the template gallery and the sidebar wordmark. Inside the editors that warmth survives only as the syrup accent on the primary action, focus ring, selection and active sidebar item. That split is deliberate, and new work keeps it.

The ruler is the recurring motif: the homepage's word-ruler backdrop, the docs and slides rulers, the grid itself, and mono uppercase labels set like tick marks.
keyCharacteristics: Two layers on one token source (`@wafflebase/core/tokens`): neutral editor chrome, warm brand surfaces.
One accent, syrup, carrying every "this is the action" signal.
Flat by default: borders and tonal steps before shadows.
Small, exact controls; Google-suite-familiar placement inside the editors.
Light and dark are paired token for token; neither is an afterthought.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Syrup is the only chromatic signal in editor chrome. If two things on a toolbar are syrup, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Two Ledgers Rule
rules.body: Editor and workspace screens use the zinc semantic tokens (`bg-background`, `text-foreground`, `border`). Brand surfaces use the `--wb-*` tokens. Don't mix them on one surface.

rules.name: The Canvas Hex Rule
rules.body: Brand colors are authored as hex because the Canvas engines assign them straight to `fillStyle`. Add a new brand color to `packages/core/src/tokens/palette.ts`, never inline in an engine.

rules.name: The Serif Is a Signature Rule
rules.body: Fraunces never appears inside an editor or on a control. It is the brand's voice, used for wordmarks and brand-surface headings only.

rules.name: The Document Owns Its Fonts Rule
rules.body: Text inside a sheet, doc or slide uses the document's own font picker (the curated family list and Google Fonts catalog), never the UI stack.

rules.name: The Rule Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Reach for a 1px border or a tonal step first. A shadow means the element floats above the canvas (menu, popover, dialog, drag ghost), not that it's important.

dos: **Do** take every color from `@wafflebase/core/tokens` (semantic classes in the app, `--wb-*` on brand surfaces), in both light and dark.
**Do** keep editor controls at 28px (toolbar) and 36px (forms) on fine pointers, and let them grow to 44px on coarse pointers.
**Do** use the 3px 50%-syrup focus ring for every focusable control.
**Do** separate panels with 1px rules and tonal steps before considering a shadow.
**Do** place and behave like the Google suite in the editors (menus, toolbar order, shortcuts).
donts: **Don't** use Fraunces, cream paper or pill buttons inside an editor or workspace screen.
**Don't** introduce a second accent color in editor chrome; status colors (destructive, warning, leaf) are for status only.
**Don't** hard-code a hex in a component or engine when a token exists.
**Don't** add decorative shadows or gradients to app chrome.
